basic_info.description: Apt #1 at 228 Vicksburg opens onto a remarkable private backyard sun-drenched, cedar-fenced, and beautifully landscaped outdoor retreat of rare scale that rivals many single-family homes in Noe Valley. Inside, the 2-level Stock CO-OP home balances scale and intimacy, with soaring ceilings, abundant natural light, & a layout designed for both quiet retreat and entertaining. On the main level, two en-suite bedrooms are complemented by a formal office easily adaptable as a third bedroom while the kitchen, anchored by a striking island & fitted with a full Thermador suite, flows seamlessly into the living & dining areas. The lower level adds a versatile dimension with a spacious media room or guest en-suite, offering flexibility for extended stays or private retreat. Throughout, rich wood floors, custom detailing, advanced soundproofing, and curated finishes reflect a standard of craftsmanship uncommon in new construction. Modern comforts include AC throughout, smart lighting, in-unit laundry, and 1 tandem parking space. A 3.8KW solar system further enhances efficiency, while the seamless indoor-outdoor connection to the private backyard underscores the home's rare blend of timeless comfort and contemporary design, all set in SF's most coveted neighborhoods.
